Has the news of the Big Day reached you?
Some faces on that Day will be low and sad.
They will work hard and be tired.
They will go into a very hot fire.
They will be given a boiling drink.
They will have no food except a bitter plant with thorns.
It does not feed them and does not stop their hunger.
Other faces on that Day will be happy.
They will be glad about what they did in this life.
They will be in a high garden.
They will not hear any useless talk there.
There is a spring that flows there.
There are high couches.
And cups set out.
And cushions lined up in rows.
And rich carpets spread out.
Do they not look at the camels and how they were made?
And at the sky and how it was lifted up?
And at the mountains and how they were set?
And at the earth and how it was spread out?
So remind them. You are only a reminder.
You are not a boss over them.
But whoever turns away and says no.
Allah will punish him with the biggest punishment.
They will come back to Us.
Then it is up to Us to count what they did.
